tabs.pet_type_default: Dogs and puppies of all breeds, including sensitive skin or digestion
tabs.benefit_1_html: Shiny coat & healthy skin: Rich in Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to soothe itching and reduce shedding.
tabs.benefit_2_html: Highly digestible & hypoallergenic: Grain-free formula without by-products for sensitive stomachs.
tabs.benefit_3_html: Joint & immune support: Enriched with natural chondroprotectors and antioxidants for daily vitality.
tabs.ing_1_desc: High biological value protein and Omega-3 source to nourish hair follicles and support joints.
tabs.ing_2_desc: Deeply hydrates the canine skin barrier while maintaining a balanced pH (7.0) and preventing flaking.
tabs.ing_3_desc: Supports healthy gut flora and protects cartilage in active or senior dogs.
tabs.composition_default: Fresh deboned salmon (40%), dehydrated fish protein (25%), sweet potato, salmon oil (source of EPA/DHA), apple pulp, glucosamine (900 mg/kg), chondroitin sulfate (700 mg/kg), yucca extract, biotin, zinc chelate. Analytical constituents: Crude protein 30%, Crude fat 16%, Crude fiber 2.8%, Crude ash 7.5%, Omega-3 1.4%.
tabs.step_1_html: Adjust by weight & activity: Check your dog's size (Mini, Medium, or Maxi) before dosing.
tabs.step_2_html: Serve or apply gradually: For food, split into 2 daily meals; for shampoo, apply onto a wet coat.
tabs.step_3_html: Action / absorption time: Gently massage for 3–5 minutes down to the roots, or always serve with fresh water.
tabs.step_4_html: Complete their routine: Pair with regular brushing and book a professional grooming session every 4–6 weeks.

grooming_steps.kicker: How we do it at the salon
grooming_steps.heading: Their 4-step coat & hygiene routine
grooming_steps.subheading: What we do at every visit, so you can keep it up at home between appointments.
grooming_steps.pick_product: Pick a product for this step in the theme editor.
grooming_steps.salon_link: Book their bath at the salon
grooming_steps.error: Couldn't add it. Please try again.
grooming_steps.step_1_text: Remove dead hair and knots before getting them wet: water makes knots tighter.
grooming_steps.step_2_text: A gentle oat shampoo and a thorough rinse. Don't overdo it: too many baths dry the skin.
grooming_steps.step_3_text: A dental snack a day helps keep tartar and bad breath down between cleanings.
grooming_steps.step_4_text: A little balm after walks prevents cracks from asphalt, cold and heat.

default_es.text_1: Quita el pelo muerto y los nudos antes de mojarlo: con el agua, los nudos se aprietan.
default_es.text_2: Champú suave de avena y un buen aclarado. Sin pasarse: bañarlo demasiado reseca la piel.
default_es.text_3: Un snack dental al día ayuda a frenar el sarro y el mal aliento entre limpiezas.
default_es.text_4: Un poco de bálsamo tras el paseo evita las grietas del asfalto, el frío y el calor.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions about an order, a product or a grooming appointment? Here is how to find us and the answers to what we are asked most.
contact.booking_text: Want to book a grooming appointment? Pick the service, day and time in a couple of minutes.
contact.q_shipping: How long does shipping take and how much is it?
contact.a_shipping: To mainland Spain it takes {{ days }} business days, and shipping is free over {{ amount }}. Frozen BARF travels separately, chilled in an insulated box, arrives within 24 h of dispatch and ships free over {{ frozen_amount }}.
contact.q_islands: Do you ship to the Balearic or Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla?
contact.a_islands: For now we only ship to mainland Spain. If you live on the islands, in Ceuta or Melilla, write to us and we will let you know when we can reach you.
contact.a_returns: Yes: you have 14 days from delivery to return unopened products. Frozen products cannot be returned. Write to us from the form with your order number and we will tell you how.
contact.q_booking: How do I book grooming and how much is it?
contact.a_booking: From “Book an appointment”: choose the service, your dog's size, the day and time, and see the estimated price before confirming. You get an email confirmation and a reminder the day before.
contact.q_change: Can I change or cancel my appointment?
contact.a_change: Yes. Let us know as soon as possible by replying to the confirmation email or from the form on this page, so we can free the slot for another dog.
contact.q_loyalty: Do you have a loyalty card?
contact.a_loyalty: Yes: every grooming visit earns a stamp, and every 10 visits your dog gets a free bath. See it in your account, under “My dogs”.
contact.form_intro: We will reply by email as soon as we can.
